title: Tell me about yourself
prompt: So, tell me a little about yourself.

title: Why this role?
prompt: Why do you want this job?

title: A time you failed
prompt: Tell me about a time you failed, and what you did next.

title: Your biggest weakness
prompt: What would you say is your biggest weakness?

title: Why should we hire you?
prompt: We have a lot of strong candidates. Why should we hire you?

title: A conflict with a coworker
prompt: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a coworker. How did you handle it?

title: Your proudest work
prompt: What's the piece of work you're proudest of, and why?

title: Where in five years?
prompt: Where do you see yourself in five years?

title: Why are you leaving?
prompt: Why are you looking to leave your current role?

title: A tough decision
prompt: Walk me through a difficult decision you had to make with incomplete information.

title: Handling pressure
prompt: Tell me about a time you were under a lot of pressure. What did you do?

title: Explain a gap
prompt: I see a gap on your resume. Can you walk me through it?

title: Salary expectations
prompt: What are your salary expectations for this role?

title: Questions for us
prompt: We're almost out of time. Do you have any questions for us?

title: Push back on a deadline
prompt: Your manager wants this finished by Friday. It can't be done well by then. Tell them.

title: Ask for a raise
prompt: You've asked for a meeting with your manager to talk about a raise. Make your case.

title: Say no to extra work
prompt: A colleague asks you to take on their project while you're already at capacity. Say no, kindly.

title: Disagree in a meeting
prompt: Everyone in the meeting likes the plan. You think it's a mistake. Speak up.

title: Take credit for your work
prompt: Your manager just praised a teammate for work you mostly did. Set the record straight, gracefully.

title: Give hard feedback
prompt: A teammate's work keeps arriving late and it's affecting you. Tell them.

title: Correct someone senior
prompt: A senior leader just stated a number that's wrong in front of the team. Correct it.

title: Ask for help
prompt: You're stuck and behind. Ask your manager for help without sounding like you're failing.

title: Return a bad order
prompt: Your meal arrived cold and wrong. Explain the problem to the server.

title: Negotiate a price
prompt: You're buying a used car and the price is too high. Negotiate.

title: Set a boundary
prompt: A friend keeps calling late at night to vent. Tell them you need that to change.

title: Interrupted again
prompt: You keep getting talked over in meetings. Take the floor back and finish your point.

title: Apologise for a mistake
prompt: You made a mistake that cost your team a day. Own it.

title: Ask for a promotion
prompt: Tell your manager you want to be considered for the next promotion, and why.

title: Pitch your idea
prompt: You have 90 seconds with the head of your team. Pitch an idea you believe in.

title: Open a talk
prompt: You're first up at a conference. Open your talk and win the room in the first minute.

title: A tough question
prompt: Halfway through your presentation someone asks: 'Why should we trust these numbers?' Answer.

title: Explain a chart
prompt: Your slide shows sales dropping 20 percent last quarter. Walk the room through it.

title: Present bad news
prompt: Your project is two months behind. Present that to leadership.

title: Close a talk
prompt: You've reached your last slide. Close the presentation so people remember it.

title: Introduce a speaker
prompt: You're introducing the next speaker, someone you admire. Introduce them.

title: The elevator pitch
prompt: You get in an elevator with an investor. Pitch your startup before the doors open.

title: Summarise a report
prompt: Leadership didn't read the 30-page report. Summarise what matters.

title: Demo something
prompt: Demo a product you use every day, as if to people who've never seen it.

title: Recover from a blank
prompt: You've just lost your place mid-presentation. Recover and keep going.

title: Defend your plan
prompt: A director says your plan is too risky. Defend it.

title: Explain your research
prompt: Explain what you've been working on to a room of people outside your field.

title: A short toast to the team
prompt: Your team shipped a big project. Say a few words to celebrate it.

title: Status update
prompt: It's stand-up. Give your update on what you're working on.

title: Explain a decision
prompt: Explain to your team why you chose the option you did, and what you ruled out.

title: Summarise the discussion
prompt: The meeting went in circles. Summarise where things landed and the next steps.

title: Kick off a meeting
prompt: You called this meeting. Open it: why everyone's here and what you need.

title: Ask a good question
prompt: The presenter just finished. Ask a question that moves things forward.

title: Introduce yourself to a new team
prompt: It's your first day. Introduce yourself to the team in the welcome meeting.

title: Raise a risk
prompt: You see a risk nobody's mentioned. Raise it without sounding negative.

title: Explain a delay
prompt: A client is on the call and their delivery is late. Explain why and what happens now.

title: Brainstorm out loud
prompt: The team needs ideas to cut costs by 10 percent. Throw out your best one and build on it.

title: Run a retrospective
prompt: The project just wrapped. Lead the team through what went well and what didn't.

title: Onboard a new hire
prompt: Explain to a new hire how your team works and what they should focus on first.

title: Wrap up with actions
prompt: Close the meeting: who's doing what, and by when.

title: Explain your role
prompt: Someone from another department asks what your team actually does. Explain.

title: Give a quick opinion
prompt: Your boss turns to you mid-meeting: 'What do you think?' Answer.

title: A wedding toast
prompt: You're the best friend at the wedding. Give the toast.

title: Explain your job
prompt: At a party, someone asks what you do. Explain it so they actually get it.

title: Introduce yourself
prompt: You're at a networking event. Introduce yourself to a stranger.

title: Recommend a book
prompt: Convince a friend to read the best book you've read this year.

title: Give directions
prompt: A tourist asks how to get from your home to your favourite spot in town. Explain.

title: Tell a funny story
prompt: Tell the funniest thing that's happened to you recently.

title: Explain a hobby
prompt: Explain your favourite hobby to someone who's never tried it.

title: Eulogy for a pet
prompt: Say a few words remembering a pet, real or imagined.

title: Plan a trip
prompt: Convince your friends to go on a trip to a place you love.

title: Explain the news
prompt: Explain a news story from this week to someone who missed it.

title: Comfort a friend
prompt: A friend just lost their job. Say something that actually helps.

title: Teach something simple
prompt: Teach someone how to make your favourite drink.

title: Leave a voicemail
prompt: Leave a clear voicemail rescheduling an important appointment.

title: Persuade on dinner
prompt: Convince the group to go to the restaurant you picked tonight.
